description: Search public Bluesky posts by keyword, read an account's posts, or read a post and its replies. Returns exact like, reply, repost, and quote counts, dates, hashtags, links, and images. No login. Pay per event on Apify.

authors.description: Bluesky handles, profile addresses, or DIDs, up to 20. Returns each account's own posts, newest first.

bluesky_app_password.description: Optional. Create an app password in Bluesky settings; never use your main password. Sent only to Bluesky. Without it a search returns one page, about 100 posts. Accounts and post addresses need no password.

bluesky_handle.description: Optional, with the app password. Used only to page a search past its first page.

include_account_replies.description: yes or no. Default no. Used for accounts.

include_replies.description: yes or no. Default no. Reads the replies under each post found. Each reply is a charged row.

include_reposts.description: yes or no. Default no. Used for accounts. A repost row shows the original author.

language.description: Language code such as en or de. Used for queries. Reads the language the post's author set.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_posts_per_source.description: Per query or account, up to 2000. Default 100. A search with no app password stops at about 100.

post_urls.description: Addresses of Bluesky posts to read, up to 100.

queries.description: Keywords to search, up to 20. Without your own app password each search returns one page, about 100 posts. Text from Clay splits on new lines, so a query can hold a comma.

since_date.description: Only posts from this date, such as 2026-10-01.

sort.description: latest or top. Default latest. Used for queries.

until_date.description: Only posts before this date, such as 2026-11-01.

name: get_bluesky_posts
title: Get Bluesky posts
